evidence: Evidence events may omit accountability only when contained in a package providing effective accountability for every referenced item; assessment inputs cannot claim completeness with unaccountable evidence.
Trusted identity policy mandates OIDC issuer, source URI, protected ref, workflow identity, release captain, and required approval refs; signer mismatch fails verification.
Risk classification records observed autonomy/impact and externally declared oversight only; sdp-trace is prohibited from deriving required_oversight.
Metric streams require stream-level assessment_state partial or not_assessed when any sample or comparison is unassessed.
Artifact safety scan is explicitly a lower-bound automated check; accountable evidence-owner approval remains required for customer-facing examples.
Contract manifests must declare exactly one of valid_until or freshness_policy; omission fails validation.
Accountable identity objects restrict actor_type to human_user, human_role, or human_group, enabling machine-readable rejection of AI-as-sole-accountable-owner.
Offline structural validation and release verification are separated; private equivalents must specify envelope binding, identity source, timestamp/freshness evidence, and audit-log status.
Rollback protection is explicitly limited to previous_manifest_digest continuity plus freshness; full TUF features are excluded to a future block.
Block completion requires one real release verification evidence record for the target profile or approved private equivalent; schema-only is insufficient.
